description: PG9 (2026-10-13 parity review): a recognised GitOps failure (gitopsinsight.FailureClassNamespaceNotFound) must reach a real fix through the ordinary pull-request route, not just a correct root cause. The Application is Argo-managed, so the route resolves to pullRequest, which permits only OpenPR and DeleteResource (internal/resolution.PermittedActionTypes) — the right fix here is a pull request adding the missing Namespace (or setting CreateNamespace=true), never a live patch.
